purpose: Explicit, reproducible static task inventory for planning-interface preparation; not a frozen formal evaluation protocol.

selection.ordering: Explicit numeric problem suffix, not filesystem glob order. This is a project adaptation; the original 2/8 membership is not claimed to be identical.
selection.strategy_selection_note: No independent strategy-selection set is configured. Do not perform adaptive strategy/candidate selection against sealed tasks. A later protocol must define a disjoint selection design before such selection.

access_rules.prompt: Domain and these two problem files may be used to initialize the solver after runtime authorization.
access_rules.development_feedback: Only these eight tasks may provide task execution feedback in the planned single-step pilot.
access_rules.sealed_evaluation: Paths and hashes may be audited; task contents, validation traces and scores must remain outside proposer/updater context and candidate selection. Not evaluated in this preparation.
access_rules.inventory_not_selected: Recorded for provenance and duplicate audit only; not enabled for this pilot.

static_audit.problem_name_normalization: Replace (problem <name>) header with (problem NAME); preserve remaining text; SHA-256 of UTF-8 text. This does not test object renaming, graph isomorphism, or semantic equivalence.

remaining_readiness_requirements: Confirm execution authorization and evaluator isolation.
Verify PDDL parser and VAL binary on the actual Linux runtime, including infrastructure failure classification.
Specify independent strategy-selection data if selection is enabled.
Freeze model, resource limits, repetition design, and final evaluation protocol before experiments.
evidence_boundary: Official text was downloaded and hashed in a temporary audit directory. No original PDDL is vendored here. No generated program, planner, validator, model, or task dependency was executed or installed.
